summary: Avalanche Studios' open-world action series built around Rico Rodriguez, grappling, parachuting, and large-scale destruction.

primary.why: The Windows release is the highest-fidelity and most configurable route; the Windows version is based on the original Xbox release.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release through Steam/GOG or another PC storefront, applying compatibility fixes as needed.

primary.why: Just Cause 2 shipped on Windows, PS3, and Xbox 360; Windows is the highest-fidelity and most configurable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release through Steam/GOG or another PC storefront with compatibility fixes as needed.

primary.why: Just Cause 3 shipped on Windows, PS4, and Xbox One; Windows XXL/current release is the best route with DLC support and higher settings.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows XXL/current release with all owned DLC installed and patch version noted.

primary.why: Just Cause 4 shipped on Windows, PS4, and Xbox One; Windows Complete/current release is the best route with DLC support and higher settings.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Complete/current release with all DLC installed and patch version noted.

entries.title: Just Cause Mobile

primary.why: Just Cause Mobile had a regional early-access rollout but was cancelled before global launch in July 2023.
primary.how_to_play: Do not choose a definitive route; only document early-access preservation if a legally preserved regional build exists.

entries.remaster_caveats: Cancelled mobile title; revisit only for preservation of regional early-access builds.
